card.name: Start of drug names beginning with N
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug brand or generic name that begins with N or Z, such as nivolumab, nilotinib, nintedanib, or Ninlaro. It is most common after 'with', 'and', 'on' or 'prior to' in dosing text.

modes.label: Nivolumab after combination wording
modes.description: The opening 'n' of nivolumab after 'and' or 'in combination with'.
modes.example: CABOMETYX in combination with<< n>>ivolumab can cause hepatic toxicity

modes.label: Other N-drug names
modes.description: The opening letter of nilotinib, nintedanib or Ninlaro when it follows a verb or heading.
modes.example: 2.1 Testing Prior to<< N>>intedanib Capsules Administration Conduct

modes.label: Zydelig start
modes.description: The first piece of Zydelig after 'treated with'.
modes.example: pneumonitis occurred in 4% of patients treated with<< Zy>>delig compared to 1% on

card.writes: It pushes toward continuations like 'sens' and 'overcome', which gives little clear link to the drug names.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter or two of a cancer drug name like nivolumab or nilotinib.
